Upholding values of safety, quality, and employee relations, the Plant Manager will prioritize the development and supervision of production staff, with a particular emphasis on cultivating future leaders. Additional responsibilities encompass plant safety, creating work schedules, implementing process enhancements, and conducting inspections.

This role involves coordinating with multiple departments, supporting the development of production staff, and helping build future leaders within the organization.
cond_0261.responsibilities:
Work alongside daily plant operations teams to ensure smooth coordination.
Coordinate production schedules and material requirements in collaboration with Purchasing, Project Management, Installation, and Order Entry teams.
Partner with the Maintenance Department to schedule machinery maintenance, minimizing disruptions and ensuring continuous plant functionality.
Recruit, train, develop, and mentor both direct and indirect staff members.
Support plant safety efforts, help create work schedules, assist with process improvements, and participate in inspections.
Work with production teams to achieve year-over-year improvements.
Collaborate across departments, sharing information to support timely production and cost-saving decisions.
Use MS Office suite and ERP systems, preferably Syteline, to support operations.
Apply knowledge of payroll, budgeting, and accounting principles as needed.
Perform any other assigned duties as required.
The above description outlines general duties and may not encompass all responsibilities.
cond_0261.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Experience in complex production scheduling
Experience leading skilled labor
Knowledge of payroll, budgeting, and accounting principles
Proficiency in MS Office suite and ERP systems
Preferred Requirements
Experience with Syteline or similar ERP bolt-on applications
Background in developing and mentoring production staff
Experience cultivating future leaders in a plant environment
